findings.title: Unchecked type assertion can panic
findings.message: `parent` is typed as `tree.Node`, and the code asserts it to `core.Widget` without the comma-ok form. If a caller passes a non-widget tree node, this panics after the tree has already been mutated, leaving a half-updated state. The current driver passes a `core.Frame`, so this is a latent risk from the function signature.
findings.suggestion: Use the comma-ok form, or change the `parent` parameter type to `core.Widget` so the compiler enforces it.

findings.title: Parking loop does not guard against nil record or widget
findings.message: The parking loop moves every retained record's widget without a nil check. The cleanup loop a few lines later guards the same widget with `!tree.IsNil(r.widget)`. If any record has a nil or invalid widget, `MoveToParent` may panic or corrupt the tree before the rebuild starts. The code treats this as possible in one place and not in the other.
findings.suggestion: Skip nil records and widgets in the parking loop, as the cleanup loop does.
